quotes.text: "no virtual folder summary should be created beneath the URI-derived path"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: AddSubfolder derives the child path from the parent's stored directory and assigns it before returning the child. VirtualFolderHelper then opens the new child's database. The regression task sets a suffixed parent path, creates the wrong URI-derived directory too, and checks creation plus three completed moves. These are static path/order and test-oracle facts; the test simulates the collision state, and no filesystem, server or restart test ran.
title: IMAP AddSubfolder fixes the child path before a virtual folder opens its summary
